summary: The full heartbeat-domain D1 WRITE path was live-exercised for one deliberate window on an ordinary (non-canary) admin-watchdog dispatch run. Both write-authority vars were coordinated to d1 while read authority stayed supabase; the ordinary heartbeat landed in D1 with the real GitHub run id and an empty detail, the Supabase watchdog row stayed exactly at baseline, and all authority/bindings were restored to resting supabase afterwards. This proves the full D1 WRITE path for the tested ordinary run/window. D1 READ authority/parity is NOT live-proven, so M11 remains incomplete.

whatThisProves: the full heartbeat-domain D1 WRITE path works for an ordinary (non-canary) admin-watchdog run: both write-authority vars coordinated to d1 produced a D1 watchdog row with the real GitHub run id and no marker
the Supabase watchdog row was untouched during the D1-write window, proving the ordinary write resolved to D1 and not Supabase
the OIDC-authenticated boundary accepted the ordinary run with zero auth failures (two POST /v1/ops/heartbeat calls, both 200 outcome ok)
authority changes can be applied and rolled back in the safe documented order and the resting boundary rejects unauthenticated access
whatThisDoesNotProve: a D1 READ authority: reads remained Supabase throughout, and no live d1 read authority or read parity is claimed
fail-closed behavior under a live D1 failure: only the existing fail-closed unit test is accepted, no destructive live fault injection was performed
M11 completion: admin_ops_events (M11.4), ingest and core/publication remain pending
